---
title: "01 — Master HCS domain"
format: html
---

## Goal

Define and freeze the reusable Humboldt Current System master domain before any bulk environmental acquisition.

## Required decisions

- geographic bounding box in EPSG:4326;
- scientific justification for the north/south/offshore limits;
- whether the master domain is continuous or composed of named subdomains;
- Peru and Chile coverage requirements;
- static coastline and land-mask source;
- prediction/extraction buffer policy;
- relationship between the master HCS domain and project-specific subdomains.

## Rules

- Do not derive the master domain from species presence alone.
- Do not download different spatial domains independently for each paper when one master product can be reused.
- Preserve the provider-native grid in `cin/raw/`.
- Project-specific cropping belongs downstream and must be reproducible from the master source.

## Outputs

- frozen `config/domain.yml`;
- map of the master domain;
- area and coordinate audit;
- named subdomain registry if required;
- `GO / REVIEW / STOP` decision.

## Current status

**REVIEW — coordinates intentionally unset.**
